audit.whatIsWrong: Every level-chart cell (win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side) read 'Ryze' on a 50.23% matchup whose own prose (whys[], early/mid) says Galio owns levels 2 through first item.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill / Galio / Galio / Galio / Galio / Galio / Ryze, and the mirror audit reached the same conclusion. Enum fields are exempt from the length band, so the flips apply cleanly.
audit.corrected: Skill, Galio, Galio, Galio, Galio, Galio, Ryze with matching ratings (5/10, 4/10, 4/10, 4/10, 4/10, 5/10, 7/10), proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why sells Realm Warp as a duelling spike.
audit.why: Realm Warp is a delayed group teleport with no combat steroid, while Hero's Entrance (180/160/140s, 4000-5500 range) matches Ryze's map pressure from anywhere. Level 6 does not upgrade the duel.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is macro-only for Ryze; the real flip is Seraph's plus a second mana item at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Interactions were stated vaguely ('his dash knockup') and the auto-attack tell was absent.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s at 650 range; Shield of Durand is 18/17/16/15/14s and both shields and taunts, blunting the Flux chain that Rune Prison sets up. Colossal Smash is an empowered auto with an auto-reset wind-up — that wind-up, not a cast, is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Track Justice Punch's real cooldown, treat Shield of Durand as the reason short trades beat extended ones, and read the Colossal Smash wind-up as the burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Colossal Smash as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Listed in _missing for this matchup and confirmed by the kit's autoReset flag.
audit.corrected: Added to the Key Ability Interactions line.

edits.before: W root threatens jungle follow-up, but it's also your kite tool — spending it greedily is how you die.
edits.after: Shield of Durand (18s) eats your root trade and taunts you back — hold W as anti-engage, not as poke.

edits.before: Full kit: E-Flux into W root into Q chain is your trade. Fluxed minions make the wave itself your weapon.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Justice Punch (11s) closes 650 units — trade only through a Fluxed minion, never open.

edits.before: Phase Rush turns his engage into your trade window — combo, proc the speed, and walk away untouched.
edits.after: His MR and Shield of Durand blunt the Flux chain — combo, proc Phase Rush, and leave before the taunt.

edits.before: Realm Warp opens flanks and escapes, and your EQ DPS now duels most tops on their cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Realm Warp is a group teleport, not a duel steroid; Hero's Entrance matches your map play anywhere.

edits.before: Rod of Ages ends the HP problem — your short trades become favourable on raw math.
edits.after: Rod of Ages ends the HP problem, but his MR buy still holds the damage edge for now.

edits.before: Your EQ shreds tanks — farm, poke, and out-scale a lane that can't ever kill you.
edits.after: Your EQ shreds tanks, but his MR and taunt hold lane — farm and out-scale him.
